sources.name: ammkrn/nanoda_lib
sources.rules: parser.rs 619-633 raw levels; tc.rs infer_sort/infer_pi/def_eq_sort; level.rs simplify/combining and symbolic comparison. No source changes.

expectations: P1/M1/I1 are byte-identical valid controls. Pbad omits the used u parameter; Mbad lowers the declared universe level by one; Ibad replaces imax by max and is wrong at u=0. Exact source-derived arguments, prospective outcomes and altered-record counts are in cases.json.
rules: Official type_checker.cpp check_level, infer_sort, infer_pi, and sort-level equivalence; level.cpp mk_imax returns zero when rhs is zero. Nanoda tc.rs infer_sort checks all_uparams_defined (line554), infer_pi folds imax, assert_def_eq (line955) requires inferred/ascribed types to match; level.rs compares symbolic levels. Pbad must fail its parameter guard, Mbad/Ibad must fail type conversion.
demand: Reuse raw Replay.lean: print parsed params, type and value before empty-environment trust0 kernel replay; require exact equality to cases.json for every case, including rejected ones. Nanoda parser directly inserts raw param/max/imax levels (source bound by observed hashes); error attribution must reach the intended checker guard. Both consume exactly the same input bytes verified before and after.
classification: Exit status alone is insufficient. Official REJECT requires the expected undefined-universe or declaration-type-mismatch diagnostic after exact parsed-object prints. Nanoda uses assertion panics for invalid inputs: classify an expected all_uparams_defined assertion from infer_sort or def_eq assertion from assert_def_eq as REJECT_VIA_ASSERTION, preserving the nonzero code and panic text. Distinguish these intentional rejection paths from parser/unsupported failures, timeouts, unrelated diagnostic panics and crashes. Valid controls require exit0 and explicit one-declaration completion, with no stderr. Any unknown failure is diagnosed/repaired within this item, never silently mapped to REJECT.
process_controls: Outer supervised matrix300s; each guest timeout120s with kill-after10s; supervisor host-client memory4GiB, sample1s,maxgap5s,cleanup10s, outputcap20MiB. Existing container memory12GiB,cpu4,pids512,no-new-privileges; VM RAM~7.7GiB. Controls are nonterminal; diagnose/repair any failures without altering the frozen six cases. HostCLI RSS is not guest checker memory.
execution: Same offline ARM64 container and cached Lean4.34.1/Nanoda/parser; non-root UID1001. Direct lean with compiled parser LEAN_PATH, no Lake resolution, no Mathlib or source build. One outer supervised matrix; individual guest120s timeout/kill-after10s; no fixed attempt budget.
preparation_repair: Initial docker start failed because the daemon was stopped. Starting Docker Desktop restored the same cached profile; initial failure and successful retry retained. No checker observations occurred during preparation.
limitations: Three constructed invalid/valid pairs at two pinned revisions; no independent fault holdout, detection rate, global soundness or branch-coverage claim. No model calls in launch/analysis loops; no delegation this item.
